description: This file defines the EmbeddingManager class responsible for managing OpenAI embeddings. It includes methods for embedding individual text strings and batches of texts asynchronously using the openai library.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: Manages OpenAI embeddings, providing methods for embedding text and batches of texts asynchronously.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the EmbeddingManager with API client, model, and batch size settings.

methods.name: List[float] embed_text(self, text: str)
methods.description: Embeds a single text string asynchronously and returns its embedding vector.

methods.name: List[List[float]] batch_embed(self, texts: List[str])
methods.description: Embeds multiple texts in batches asynchronously, returning a list of embedding vectors.

ctags.name: batch_embed
ctags.pattern: /^    async def batch_embed(self, texts: List[str]) -> List[List[float]]:$/

ctags.name: embed_text
ctags.pattern: /^    async def embed_text(self, text: str) -> List[float]:$/
